corrections: (c) 装 app 比例:"仅 56.8%" → 该数字在原文中不存在,且混淆了两个不同环节。原文:"Of the 467 codes, 272 were redeemed; ∼41.7% of participants therefore did not sign up for the app used to block mobile internet. Of these 272, 266 set up the initial mobile internet block"。即:领取/注册 app = 272/467 = 58.2%(原文以"41.7% 没注册"的否定式表述);真正设置了初始屏蔽 = 266/467 = 56.9%。承重论断若要保留单一数字,应写"注册 app 58.2%、实际设置屏蔽 56.9%"。25.5% 合规率本身逐字成立:"119 (25.5% of those who committed) met our preregistered definition of 'compliant' (having the block active for at least 10 of the 14 intervention days, as recorded by the Freedom app)"。

(b) "ITT" 的构念口径:数值逐字成立("The ITT pre–post intervention effects were dz = 0.45 (P < 0.001) for SWB, dz = 0.56 (P < 0.001) for mental health and dz = 0.23 (P < 0.001) for sustained attention"),但作者定义的 ITT 是"不按合规性剔除participants"("We focus our analyses on intention-to-treat (ITT) effects, without excluding any participants based on compliance, while also reporting treatment-on-treated (TOT) effects as secondary analyses"),而非缺失数据意义上的 ITT:分析基于 313 名三期全完成者(313/467 = 67%),未对 467 做插补。且这三个 dz 是两组干预期合并后的**被试内前后变化**,不是随机化组间对照。对应 TOT(仅合规者):SWB dz = 0.50、mental health dz = 0.68、sustained attention dz = 0.26 (P = 0.009)。

(b) mental health 构念:"DSM-5 Level 1" 成立但需限定——它是**五域反向计分合成指数**,非抑郁单项。原文:"mental health (a reverse-scored index including symptoms of depression, anxiety, anger, personality function, and social anxiety; dz = 0.57, P < 0.001)";量表来源"Items were taken from the corresponding subscales of the DSM-5 Level 1 cross-cutting symptom measure for adults"。

(a) N=467 的口径:467 是**去重后承诺参与**的人数,不是随机化人数。原文:"We received 504 complete responses to the baseline survey, with 253 randomly assigned to the Intervention group and 251 to the Delayed Intervention group. After removing duplicate email addresses, phone numbers, and Prolific IDs, we retained 467 unique participants." 实际进入主分析的是 313 人("327 participants completed both the T1 and T2 self-report surveys (70%), and 313 completed all three surveys (67%)")。故应表述为"随机化 504 / 去重承诺 467 / 分析 313"。

(e) "larger than antidepressants" 的不可比性:承重论断方向正确且可进一步坐实。原文"The observed effect of the intervention on depression symptoms (dz = 0.56) was larger than the meta-analytic effect of antidepressants [29]",ref 29 确为 Kirsch I, et al. 2008. Initial severity and antidepressant benefits: a meta-analysis of data submitted to the food and drug administration. PLoS Med. 5:e45。核 Kirsch 一手:0.32 是**药物减安慰剂的组间差**("difference between improvement in the drug groups and improvement in the placebo groups was 0.32";HRSD 差 1.80 分)。而 Kirsch 中与本文 dz 同口径的**药物组被试内前后变化**为 d = 1.24(HRSD 改善 9.60 分)——是 0.56 的两倍以上。故同口径比较下抗抑郁药效应远大于本干预,原文比较方向被反转。
(e) 附带的内部标签错误:该句把 dz = 0.56 称作"the effect of the intervention on depression symptoms",但 0.56 是五域 mental health 合成指数的 ITT 值;全文及附录未单独报告抑郁分量表的 dz。

(f) 314→161 分钟的适用范围:这是 Intervention 组 T1→T2 单组数据,且干预结束后回弹。原文:"In the Intervention group, the average screen time decreased from 314 min at T1 to 161 min at T2... rebounding to 265 at T3. In the Delayed Intervention group, it decreased slightly from 336 min at T1 to 322 min at T2... dropping to 190 at T3." 测量方式为参与者自行上传 iPhone 屏幕使用时间页截图,属"客观记录但自主提交",非后台自动采集。
evidence_notes: 一手全文(OUP)https://academic.oup.com/pnasnexus/article/4/2/pgaf017/8016017 与 PMC 镜像 https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11834938/ (PMID 39967678) 两处独立比对,数字一致。作者:Noah Castelo, Kostadin Kushlev, Adrian F. Ward, Michael Esterman, Peter B. Reiner;PNAS Nexus 4(2), 2025-02-01。

(a) 设计与预注册成立。摘要逐字:"We used a mobile phone application to block all mobile internet access from participants' smartphones for 2 weeks and objectively track compliance. This intervention specifically targeted the feature that makes smartphones 'smart' (mobile internet) while allowing participants to maintain mobile connection (through texts and calls) and nonmobile access to the internet (e.g. through desktop computers)." 作者确以 "cross-over design" 自述;分组:"those in the Intervention group blocked mobile internet access for the first 2 weeks only (T1–T2), while those in the Delayed Intervention group acted as a control for the first 2 weeks and then blocked mobile internet access for the second 2 weeks (T2–T3)"。预注册 OSF 链接在文中给出:https://osf.io/tfdm6 (view_only)。

(d) 自选样本与期待效应两条限制均为作者原话,承重论断成立且可加码。自选:"Our sample consisted mostly of individuals motivated to reduce their smartphone use: at the outset of the experiment, we asked how motivated participants were to reduce their smartphone use on a 1 (not at all) to 7 (very much) scale and 83% of our participants chose 5 or higher." 期待效应:"Expectancy effects, such as placebo and demand effects, could have contributed to our findings... This is a limitation of our design." 另有承重论断未提及的第三条流失偏倚:"People who completed all three time points did, however, have significantly better mental health and higher sustained attention at baseline than those who did not."

关键反证(承重论断未涵盖,但对"因果证据"强度是重大限定):随机化**组间主效应三个结局全部不显著**——mental health Condition F(1,306) = 3.39, P = 0.067;SWB Condition F(1,302) = 3.52, P = 0.062;sustained attention Condition F(1,242) = 0.32, P = 0.572。显著的是 Time×Condition 交互(分别 P < 0.001、P < 0.001、P = 0.016)。即论文对外传播的三个 dz 全部来自被试内前后变化,而非随机对照组间差。
(f) 成人样本成立:"The average age was 32 years; 63% were female",美加 Prolific 样本(15% Asian、9% Black、62% White、12% Other),无未成年人。

Kirsch 2008 一手核对(PLoS Medicine, 10.1371/journal.pmed.0050045):组间 SMD 0.32 / HRSD 1.80 分,药物组被试内前后 d = 1.24 / HRSD 9.60 分;作者并指出 1.80 分"does not meet the three-point drug–placebo criterion for clinical significance used by NICE"。

corrections: (c) 装 app 比例:修正前『仅 56.8%』→ 修正后『272/467=58.2% 兑换了 Freedom 升级码;266/467=57.0% 真正完成了首次断网设置』。论文原文口径为『Of the 467 codes, 272 were redeemed; ∼41.7% of participants therefore did not sign up for the app used to block mobile internet.』56.8% 这个数在原文中不存在,也不等于任何一组分子/分母(266/467=56.96%,272/467=58.24%)。合规 25.5% 本身无误(119/467=25.48%,论文同时给出另一分母口径 119/249=47.8% of those who downloaded and set up the Freedom app)。

(a) N=467 的性质:修正前『N=467、随机交叉』→ 修正后『基线完成 504 人并被随机分组(Intervention 253 / Delayed 251);按 email、电话、Prolific ID 去重后保留 467 人(Intervention 242 / Delayed 225)』。即 467 是随机化之后的去重存活样本,不是随机化单元数,且两臂不等(242 vs 225)。交叉设计成立,但属延迟起始(delayed-start / stepped)交叉:Intervention 组 T1–T2 断网,Delayed 组 T1–T2 作对照、T2–T3 才断网。

(b/e) dz=0.56 的构念:修正前『mental health(DSM-5 Level 1)dz=0.56』(构念表述正确)→ 但必须补一层修正:论文在做抗抑郁药对比的那句里把该值改称为『the effect of the intervention on depression symptoms (dz = 0.56)』,而该指标实为 APA DSM-5 Level 1 五域复合(depression、anxiety、anger、social anxiety、personality functioning),全文未报告任何单独的 depression 效应量。因此该对比不只是『within-subject dz 与组间 d 不可直比』的单位错配,还叠加了一层构念错配:用五域心理健康复合分去对比一项以抑郁为终点的 meta 分析。

(e) 参考文献落点:修正前『引 Kirsch 2008』(成立)→ 修正后需精确到『ref 29 = Kirsch I, Deacon BJ, Huedo-Medina TB, Scoboria A, Moore TJ, Johnson BT. Initial Severity and Antidepressant Benefits: A Meta-Analysis of Data Submitted to the Food and Drug Administration. PLoS Medicine. 2008;5(2):e45』,报告的药物-安慰剂标准化均数差 d=0.32(HRSD 差 1.80 分)。注意:检索过程中曾有二手抽取把该文献误报为 JAMA 300(16):1882–1888,系错误,已以 PLoS Medicine 原刊页面核正。另需补:论文对该对比给出的唯一保留意见是样本与情境差异(『the nature of our sample and of our intervention is quite different from those studied in clinical psychology contexts』),从未提及效应量口径不可比——即论断 (e) 的批评点原文并未自我披露。
(f) 手机使用 314→161:修正前作为全样本陈述 → 修正后『仅为 Intervention 组:T1 314 分钟 → T2 161 分钟 → T3 回弹至 265 分钟;Delayed Intervention 组为 T1 336 → T2 322 → T3 190』。即该降幅是单臂数据,且干预结束后大幅回弹,不能作为持久性证据。
(b) 统计量性质补正:三个 dz 均为论文所称『the ITT pre–post intervention effects』,即合并两臂的受试者内前后配对效应量,不是随机分组间对照效应量;论文自承无 active control。这决定了它们与任何组间 d 的不可直比性。
evidence_notes: 一手来源:Castelo N, Kushlev K, Ward AF, Esterman M, Reiner PB. 'Blocking mobile internet on smartphones improves sustained attention, mental health, and subjective well-being.' PNAS Nexus 2025;4(2):pgaf017. DOI 10.1093/pnasnexus/pgaf017;PMID 39967678;PMCID PMC11834938。核对使用 OUP 原文页(https://academic.oup.com/pnasnexus/article/4/2/pgaf017/8016017)与 PMC 全文镜像(https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11834938/)两处独立比对。PMCID 经 Europe PMC REST API 核实(https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=TITLE:%22Blocking%20mobile%20internet%20on%20smartphones%22)。

干预内容逐字成立(摘要原文):'We used a mobile phone application to block all mobile internet access from participants' smartphones for 2 weeks and objectively track compliance. This intervention specifically targeted the feature that makes smartphones "smart" (mobile internet) while allowing participants to maintain mobile connection (through texts and calls) and nonmobile access to the internet (e.g. through desktop computers).' 即论断 (a) 中『保留通话短信+电脑上网』『2 周』逐字属实。全程为 month-long RCT(T1/T2/T3 三个时点)。

三个效应量逐字核实成立:'The ITT pre–post intervention effects were dz = 0.45 (P < 0.001) for SWB', 'dz = 0.56 (P < 0.001) for mental health', 'dz = 0.23 (P < 0.001) for sustained attention'。分臂另报 sustained attention:Intervention dz=0.24 (P=0.008),Delayed dz=0.28 (P=0.003)。摘要另称 '91% of participants improved on at least one of these outcomes'。

合规链条逐字核实:'Of the 467 codes, 272 were redeemed; ∼41.7% of participants therefore did not sign up for the app used to block mobile internet.' → '266 set up the initial mobile internet block, and 249 completed all three surveys.' → 'These 119 represent ∼25.5% of the participants who completed survey 1 and agreed to keep mobile internet blocked for 2 weeks, or 47.8% of those who downloaded and set up the Freedom app.' 三个百分比自洽:119/467=25.48%,119/249=47.79%,249/313=79.6%(313 为完成全部三次调查者总数)。

论断 (d) 自选样本与期待效应逐字成立:动机自选——'At the outset of the experiment, we asked how motivated participants were to reduce their smartphone use on a 1 (not at all) to 7 (very much) scale and 83% of our participants chose 5 or higher.';期待效应——'Expectancy effects, such as placebo and demand effects, could have contributed to our findings.';另有两项作者自承限制值得纳入:无主动对照组(难以分离安慰剂效应),以及完成全部时点者基线心理健康显著更好(差异性流失,方向为高估)。

测量工具:心理健康为 APA DSM-5 Level 1 cross-cutting symptom measure for adults 的对应子量表,原文 'The mental health measures were created by the American Psychiatric Association and included brief measures of depression, anxiety, anger, social anxiety, and personality functioning.';持续注意为 gradual onset continuous performance task (gradCPT),客观任务而非自评。论断 (b) 称『DSM-5 Level 1』准确。
论断 (f) 成人样本成立:被试招自 Prolific.co 在线劳务池,'The average age was 32 years',所用量表亦为 DSM-5 Level 1 成人版。该研究不涉及青少年,若被引用于青少年屏幕时间议题必须显式标注外推。

预注册链接确在论文中给出:'The preregistration for this experiment is available at https://osf.io/tfdm6?view_only=919c2f5b0e494f7c872d9432611b083b'。论断 (a) 称『预注册 OSF』在论文自述层面成立。合规判定标准论文表述为按预注册准则『disabling the internet block fewer than five times during the intervention period』(此句为单次抽取,置信度中等,见 unresolved)。

利益相关检查:Competing Interest 声明为 'The authors declare no competing interests.';资助为 Silicon Valley Community Foundation 给 P.B.R.(grant # GR027378)。干预工具为商业软件 Freedom(premium 升级码发放给被试),论文未说明许可证系厂商捐赠还是课题经费购买,亦无致谢提及 Freedom 或其开发方。未发现厂商共同署名或数据控制迹象,故不构成已证实的利益冲突,仅记为披露颗粒度不足。

后续修正/反证检查:OUP 与 PMC 两处文章页均未显示 correction、erratum、expression of concern 或 retraction,亦无关联评论文章。经 Semantic Scholar 引文 API 拉取 25 篇引用文献,标题/摘要层面未见针对本研究的再分析、失败复制或方法学反驳;最相关的旁证为 'The Effects of Social Media Restriction: Meta-Analytic Evidence from Randomized Controlled Trials' (2025) 与 'Going Light: The Effects of Minimal Mobile Phone Adoption on Young Adults' Well-Being Depend on Motivation' (2026),后者标题即指向动机调节效应,与本研究高动机自选样本的外推局限方向一致。
unresolved: OSF 预注册正文(https://osf.io/tfdm6?view_only=...)未能取回:OSF 页面为 JS 渲染,直接抓取仅返回空壳;改走 api.osf.io/v2/registrations/tfdm6/?view_only=... 返回 404。因此『预注册』只核到论文自述与链接存在,未能独立验证预注册的主要结局、样本量目标、合规定义是否与最终发表一致(即无法排除结局切换 outcome switching)。这是本组论断中唯一未回溯到一手的结构性缺口。

合规操作定义存在抽取冲突,未能定谳:一次抽取给出『≥10 of 14 days blocked』,另一次给出『disabling the internet block fewer than five times during the intervention period』。后者与 119 这一分子在两处独立取回中一致出现,可信度更高,但未做逐字三重比对。建议引用时不要复述具体合规阈值,只用『按预注册标准判定合规者 119 人 / 25.5%』。
PubPeer 检索被拦(HTTP 403),未能确认是否存在同行的公开质疑;本轮 WebSearch 配额已在会话开始前耗尽(200/200),因此无法做开放式反证检索,反证覆盖仅限于引文网络 + 期刊页面通告两条路径。不能据此断言『无人质疑』,只能说在已查渠道内未见。
Freedom premium 许可证的取得方式(厂商捐赠 vs 经费购买)未在论文中说明,亦无法从公开页面核实;此项仅为披露颗粒度问题,不足以推翻任何论断。

corrections: (c) 「合规达预注册标准者仅 25.5%」——数字对,口径错。25.5% (119/467) 逐字属实,但「预注册标准」不成立。论文自述标准为 “having the block active for at least 10 of the 14 intervention days, as recorded by the Freedom app”;而 OSF 上唯一的预注册文件(tfdm6 = “freedom pre reg draft 06 08.docx”,2022-06-10 上传,current_version=1,从未修改)写的是:“Participants will be ‘compliant’ if they ended their session fewer than 5 times and had less than 60 minutes not in a session.” 我对该 .docx 全文做了字符串检索:‘10 of’/‘ten of’/‘14 days’/‘at least 10’/‘10 out of’ 全部 ABSENT。修正后表述:合规率 25.5% 采用的是「14 天中至少 10 天开启拦截」这一论文自定标准,该标准并不出现在预注册文件中。

(c) 「装 app 仅 56.8%」→ 56.8% 在原文中不存在(全文检索 “56.8” 无命中)。原文口径:467 个激活码中 272 个被兑换(58.2%),“∼41.7% of participants therefore did not sign up for the app”;“Of these 272, 266 set up the initial mobile internet block” → 266/467 = 57.0%。修正后:兑换码 58.2%,真正设置了首次拦截 57.0%。

(b) 「ITT 效应 dz=0.23/0.56/0.45」——数值逐字属实,但「ITT」二字会误导,必须补两个限定语。其一,这三个 dz 不是随机化组间对比,而是把两组合并后的受试内前后差:“To increase power and the precision of effect size estimates, we pooled data from both groups into combined ‘pre intervention’ (all T1 data for the Intervention and Delayed Intervention groups) and ‘post intervention’ observations (matching T2 data for the Intervention group and matching T3 data for the Delayed Intervention group).” 即延迟组的 pre 取 T1、post 取 T3,跨越 4 周(含 2 周无干预期),不含并行对照,不控制时间效应、重复测验练习效应与均值回归。其二,该合并前后分析不在预注册中(预注册规定的是 3×2 混合 ANOVA + 交互显著后做 T1→T2 / T2→T3 简单效应)。

(b) 「ITT」还需补:此处 ITT 仅指「不因不合规而排除」,并非「所有随机化者均纳入分析」。论文明言 “these analyses are based on ‘complete cases’ only—that is, participants who provided data at all three time points”。持续注意力分析实际 n≈242(干预组 130 + 延迟组 112,由 t(130)/t(112) 与 F(1,242) 推得),仅占随机化 467 人的 52%;心理健康 F(1,306) → n≈308(66%)。且论文承认流失方向不利:“Compared with participants lost to attrition, participants who completed all three time points had significantly better mental health and had better sustained attention at baseline.”

(a) 「预注册 OSF」——存在带时间戳的预注册文档,但它不是 OSF 的正式 Registration(冻结注册),而是挂在普通 project 节点 uxcwm 下的一个 .docx 文件。OSF API 的 GUID 解析显示 tfdm6 的 type 为 “files”(不是 registration/node);api.osf.io/v2/registrations/tfdm6/ 返回 404。修正后:「OSF 上有一份 2022-06-10 上传、单版本未改动的预注册文档」,而非「OSF 正式预注册」。时间上确在数据采集前(预注册正文写明干预自 Friday June 10 或 June 24 开始,文件 2022-06-10T02:37Z 上传,即首波开始当日),属 just-in-time。

(a) 「N=467」——作为分析基线样本正确,但需补随机化与流失口径:“We received 504 complete responses to the baseline survey, with 253 randomly assigned to the Intervention group and 251 to the Delayed Intervention group. After removing duplicate email addresses, phone numbers, and Prolific IDs, we retained 467 unique participants (242 in Intervention and 225 in Delayed Intervention)”;完成全部三次调查者仅 313 人(67%)。

(b) 「mental health(DSM-5 Level 1)」——来源正确但成分与预注册不符。论文的心理健康指数由 5 个分量表构成:“depression, anxiety, anger, social anxiety, and personality functioning”(另加社交焦虑严重度量表的 1 个条目,α = 0.90);而预注册写明取「six symptom groups」的平均,明确包含 repetitive behaviors。该维度被删除,论文未标注为偏离预注册。

(e) 「larger than antidepressants 引 Kirsch 2008 且 dz 与组间 d 不可直比」——方向成立,且实际问题比论断所述更严重。引文确为 ref 29 “Kirsch I, et al. 2008. Initial severity and antidepressant benefits: a meta-analysis of data submitted to the food and drug administration. PLoS Med. 5:e45.”。Kirsch 的 d = 0.32 是「药物减安慰剂」的组间标准化均差;论文的 dz = 0.56 是未扣除安慰剂/期待/均值回归的受试内前后变化。同口径比较应对 Kirsch 的组内前后改善(药物组 9.60 HRSD 点 vs 安慰剂组 7.80 点),那样抗抑郁药的组内效应远大于 0.56——即「大于抗抑郁药」的说法在同口径下反转。额外口径错误在论文内部:原句为 “The observed effect of the intervention on depression symptoms (dz = 0.56) was larger than the meta-analytic effect of antidepressants and similar to that of cognitive behavioral therapy”,但 0.56 是五维复合指数,论文并未单独报告抑郁分量的 dz。

(f) 「手机使用 314→161 分钟/天」——数值属实但需补三个限定语:(i) 这是「总屏幕使用时间」而非「移动互联网时间」,由参与者自行上传 iPhone 屏幕使用时间截图获得(“We asked participants to upload screenshots of their iPhone's screen time page”);(ii) 仅为干预组,原文 “Average screen time decreased in the Intervention group from 314 min at T1 to 161 min at T2”,且 T3 反弹至 265;(iii) 延迟组为 336 → 322 → 190。

(f) 「成人样本」——成立但应补自选强度:Prolific US/Canada,平均年龄 32 岁,仅限 iPhone 用户;预注册的预筛还要求自报日均手机使用 > 60 分钟,且必须对 “Are you REALLY willing to block the Internet from your smartphone for 2 entire weeks…” 回答「Yes I am committed to doing this for 2 weeks!」才入组,另设「每坚持 1 天 = 1 次 $500 抽奖资格」的激励。
evidence_notes: 一手论文(OUP + PMC 双镜像一致):Castelo N, Kushlev K, Ward AF, Esterman M, Reiner PB. “Blocking mobile internet on smartphones improves sustained attention, mental health, and subjective well-being.” PNAS Nexus 4(2):pgaf017, 2025-02-18. DOI 10.1093/pnasnexus/pgaf017; PMID 39967678; PMCID PMC11834938. https://academic.oup.com/pnasnexus/article/4/2/pgaf017/8016017 与 https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11834938/
效应量逐字:“The ITT pre–post intervention effects were dz = 0.45 (P < 0.001) for SWB, dz = 0.56 (P < 0.001) for mental health and dz = 0.23 (P < 0.001) for sustained attention.” 三个数值与论断 (b) 完全一致。

合并口径逐字(关键):“To increase power and the precision of effect size estimates, we pooled data from both groups into combined ‘pre intervention’ (all T1 data for the Intervention and Delayed Intervention groups) and ‘post intervention’ observations (matching T2 data for the Intervention group and matching T3 data for the Delayed Intervention group).” —— 证明头条 dz 非随机化组间对比。

随机化对比确实存在且方向一致(对论断公平的反向证据):gradCPT 的 Condition×Time 交互 F(2,472) = 4.24, P = 0.016;干预组 T1→T2 改善 t(130) = 2.71, P = 0.008, dz = 0.24,T2→T3 无变化 (P = 0.325);延迟组 T1→T2 无变化 (P = 0.519),T2→T3 改善 t(112) = 3.03, P = 0.003, dz = 0.28。「各组只在自己被拦截的窗口内改善」这一交叉模式,是支持真实因果效应的强证据。心理健康交互 F(2,582) = 19.29, P < 0.001;SWB 交互 F(2,576) = 12.94, P < 0.001。

但随机化的 T1→T2 组间比例对比中,注意力一项不显著:“From T1 to T2, more participants in the Intervention group improved compared with those in the Delayed Intervention group (SWB: 75 vs. 47%, χ2 = 17.6, P < 0.001; mental health: 68 vs. 52%, χ2 = 13.0, P < 0.001; sustained attention: 59 vs. 46%, χ2 = 3.5, P = 0.062).” 注意力效应最弱。

参与者流程逐字:“Of the 467 codes, 272 were redeemed; ∼41.7% of participants therefore did not sign up for the app used to block mobile internet. Of these 272, 266 set up the initial mobile internet block, and 249 completed all three surveys.” 以及 “Of the 467 who committed to blocking mobile internet for 2 weeks, 266 set up the app required to do so and 119 (25.5% of those who committed) met our preregistered definition of ‘compliant’”。全文检索 “56.8” 无命中。

预注册合规标准逐字(与论文不符的核心证据):“Participants will be ‘compliant’ if they ended their session fewer than 5 times and had less than 60 minutes not in a session.” 对照论文的 “having the block active for at least 10 of the 14 intervention days”。已确认 OSF 项目 uxcwm 的 “Pre-registration and miscellaneous” 文件夹内仅有 2 个文件,预注册文档只有 1 份,无更晚版本(另一份为 2022-08-04 的 “Freedom Instructions for iPhone.docx”),排除「另有修订版预注册」的可能。

预注册的分析计划逐字:“We will run mixed ANOVA models with the following form: DV = condition * time, with time as a 3-level within-subjects factor and condition as a 2-level between-subjects factor. If the interaction term is significant, we will conduct planned contrasts…” 未提及跨组合并前后数据。ITT 确为预注册:“We will first report intent-to-treat analyses in which we include all participants regardless of whether they complied… we anticipate significant noncompliance (up to 50%)”。样本量计划:“We will recruit 500 participants”。

预注册的心理健康构念逐字:“mental health, will be measured using the American Psychiatric Association’s short measures of depression, anxiety, anger, social anxiety, repetitive behaviors, and personality functioning”,分析计划为 “the average of the six symptom groups for mental health”;论文实际只用 5 项,repetitive behaviors 未见于论文。

自选与期待效应,论文逐字承认(论断 (d) 完全成立):“Our sample consisted mostly of individuals motivated to reduce their smartphone use: at the outset of the experiment, we asked how motivated participants were to reduce their smartphone use on a 1 (not at all) to 7 (very much) scale and 83% of our participants chose 5 or higher.” 以及 “Expectancy effects, such as placebo and demand effects, could have contributed to our findings… Participants may have guessed that the intervention was intended to improve their well-being and responded accordingly even if they did not really feel better. This is a limitation of our design.”
支持期待效应实际在起作用的内部证据:同一注意力构念,自评量表(MAAS)效应 dz = −0.79(t(163) = −10.07, P < 0.001),客观 gradCPT 仅 dz = 0.23–0.24,相差约 3 倍。主观测量被放大的模式与需求特征/期待效应一致。

Kirsch 2008 一手核对(PLoS Medicine 开放获取):https://journals.plos.org/plosmedicine/article?id=10.1371/journal.pmed.0050045 —— 药物组组内改善 9.60 HRSD 点,安慰剂组 7.80 点,差值 1.80 点,标准化组间差 d = 0.32,低于 NICE 的临床显著阈值(3 点或 d = 0.50)。确认 0.32 是组间(药物减安慰剂)量,与论文的受试内 dz 不同口径。
